quote:
InputManager.as:51  internal static var maxDistance:int = 200;
MCSPlayer.as:3030   this.slashLength = this.baseSlashLength * 1.5;   -> 300
MCSPlayer.as:3041   ... * (1 + 0.5 * balancedMastery * 0.01) at mastery 0 -> 200

text: The wiki's 300/200/100 stance reach numbers reproduce exactly as the shipped default slash budget (200) times the mastery-ZERO multipliers {1.5, 1.0, 0.5}, which contradicts the ledger's reading of them as mastery-9 ceiling values.
